dei.note: PARTIAL RETRIEVAL: 12 of an unknown-but-large total confirmed via individual company press releases; the full ranked list lives behind Disability:IN's gated portal/report download (portal.disabilityin.org, disabilityin.org/resources/disability-index-report) which returned no company-level data to unauthenticated fetch, and no single public page enumerates all recognized companies for this edition. The 2026 Disability Index report states 421 unique organizations / 627 submissions across 45 countries participated overall (not all are top scorers). IMPORTANT METHODOLOGY NOTE: the 2026 edition redesigned scoring away from the legacy 0-100 numeric scale used through 2025 (where 'Best Place to Work for Disability Inclusion' = score of 100, or per some pages a lower threshold e.g. 80+) to a new instrument of 76 yes/no questions organized into six proficiency tiers; the top tier is now branded 'World's Top Disability Inclusive Business' rather than a numeric '100'. Every company below is confirmed via its own 2026-dated press release naming it a 'World's Top Disability Inclusive Business' / 'Best Place to Work for Disability Inclusion' for the 2026 Disability Index; none published a numeric score, so score is recorded as null for all (tag: 2026-top-tier). Prior-edition (2025) top-scorer confirmations seen during research but NOT included here (wrong edition, per task's 'most recent edition' instruction): Salesforce (7th year, 100), Principal Financial Group (100), Meijer (100, 8th year), Curriculum Associates, Acxiom (100, 3rd time), Milliman.
